bodyHtml:
Aquasky Pressure Tank 40L Design Change Notice ｜ Aquasky

Aquasky Pressure Tank announces 40L New Design change. The 40L tank has a new version and the dimension comparison table as shown. The 40L design changes from a 3-shell design to 2-shell design and increases the diameter.

There are two main advantages of the new design.

* First advantage is to increase the water storage volume in a large pressure difference due to the two shell design. The air can be fully compressed to increase the water storage volume by 20%.

* Second advantage is being able to lower the height to avoid high percentage of damage during shipping. The tank volume is precisely adjusted to 40L.

The new design will start in service in January 2024.
